models.name: Best model
models.description: Highest mean of balanced accuracy and F1 (β = 1). Balanced accuracy 94.77%; F1 94.74%.

models.name: Average model
models.description: Mean prediction across all 100 models. Scores are derived after averaging.

index.name: Fair SPARE-AD Index
index.description: Signed classifier output, from −1 to +1. Higher values indicate a more DA-like model pattern. Zero corresponds to p = 0.5, not the saved decision threshold.

logit.name: Fair SPARE-AD Logit
logit.description: Log-odds transform of the model output, clipped to [10⁻⁶, 1−10⁻⁶] before transformation. This is not a calibrated clinical odds estimate.

age_z.name: Fair SPARE-AD Age-Z
age_z.formula: (logit(p) − CN age trend) / CN residual SD
age_z.description: Exploratory age-referenced logit: a fixed linear trend fitted to CN reference scans outside the model-development subset. Positive values are above the CN age expectation. No uploaded observations enter this fit.
